items.title: What are oceans and continents?
items.explanation: Oceans are the vast bodies of saltwater covering most of the Earth's surface, while continents are large continuous landmasses. Together with smaller land areas called landmasses, they shape the climate and life on Earth.

items.title: Distribution of water and land
items.explanation: Oceans cover approximately three-fourths of the globe's surface, while continents occupy about one-fourth. This distribution is uneven between hemispheres, with the Pacific Ocean being the largest body of water.
